step.cmd: Refer to the appropriate task to determine which information is missing or is incorrect to provide all the required information to IPOC and go to step 4.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration number used to send the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select the same work item noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06).
Work type: Select the same work type noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .
Remarks Line 1: Type “This MM06 replaces the MM06 created on [date] for BPC [XXXX].”
Remarks Line 2 to 4: Include all required information.
Remarks Line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select the same detection code as noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06).
Infraction: Select the same infraction code as noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06).
Message: Select the same message code as noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .
